name: The Crown of Will
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details: All that remains is to deliver the Crown of Will to Sharlindra in the Undercity. She will see that it is delivered to Lady Sylvanas. I would warn you against thinking to use it for your own purposes, adventurer, Mug'Thol's fate should be illustration enough.
narrative.objectives: Deliver the Crown of Will to Sharlindra in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText:
So this is the relic the ogre used to duck the will of the Dark Lady...

Strange that something so simple could wield so great a power. And to fall into as clumsy hands as those. Well done, adventurer, I will deliver the crown to Lady Sylvanas, and see that she hears of your accomplishment.
narrative.requestItemsText: I note that your task is unfinished, adventurer. Shall I inform Sharlindra of your ineptitude?

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 39 to 43, 13,900 XP in all.

quests.name: The Crown of Will
quests.objectiveText: Report to Melisara at Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

quests.name: The Crown of Will
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Crushridge Maulers for Melisara in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: The Crown of Will
quests.objectiveText: Kill Targ, Muckrake, and Glommus and bring their heads to Melisara in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: The Crown of Will
quests.objectiveText: Kill Mug'Thol, and return his head with the Crown of Will to Melisara in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: The Crown of Will
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the Crown of Will to Sharlindra in the Undercity.
